title: BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) - Band 13 (700 MHz) for WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Ana Reyes

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) filter targeting Band 13 (700 MHz) for WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter. The filter is designed on 42° YX LiTaO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 1788.3 MHz and bandwidth of 339.4 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave)
- Frequency Band: Band 13 (700 MHz)
- Application: WiFi 6E Coexistence Filter
- Substrate: 42° YX LiTaO3
- Package: WLP (Wafer Level Package)
- Design Tool: Matlab RF Toolbox R2024b
- Design Center: Helsinki 5G Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) design targeting Band 13 (700 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       1788.3 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       339.4 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.9 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 13.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 52.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 18.0 dB
Q Factor:               5177
Temperature Coefficient:-14.7 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.5 x 1.9 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   11
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Matlab RF Toolbox R2024b and load the BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 42° YX LiTaO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 1788.3 MHz, BW 339.4 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.9 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (WLP (Wafer Level Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, 42° YX LiTaO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Rohde & Schwarz ZNA67.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 5365 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.9 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 13.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 509 MHz offset >= 52.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 3 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 3.3 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +27 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 86%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-05-17
Devices Tested:         63
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.55 dB
Return Loss (meas):     15.3 dB
Rejection (meas):       54.8 dB
Isolation (meas):       23.2 dB
Q Factor (meas):        5177
Group Delay Variation:  4.8 ns
Power Handling:         +30 dBm
Die Yield:              85.2%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The BAW (Bulk Acoustic Wave) design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 13 (700 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Wafer-level uniformity was excellent (sigma < 1.5%).
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
